tax_posture.percentage_tax: Registered for quarterly percentage tax using BIR Form 2551Q. Section 116 generally imposes 3% of gross quarterly sales on qualifying non-VAT persons; have the accountant confirm the applicable base, exclusions, threshold status, and any later amendment for each filing period.
tax_posture.corporate_income_tax: Registered for BIR Forms 1702 and 1702Q. Do not describe GSSC as using the 8% income-tax option, which is associated with qualified self-employed individuals rather than this domestic corporation.
tax_posture.withholding_tax: Registered for expanded withholding tax forms 0619E, 1601EQ, and 1604E. Apply only to transactions and periods for which withholding is legally required; maintain withholding taxes as trust funds and do not commingle them.
tax_posture.invoice_phrase: THIS DOCUMENT IS NOT VALID FOR CLAIM OF INPUT TAX
tax_posture.invoice_rule: Use INVOICE terminology and the current BIR-authorized invoice format; do not rely on legacy Official Receipt language.
tax_posture.quotation_posture: Client-facing amounts may be stated as PHP on a Non-VAT basis. Do not use “VAT-neutral” as a legal or tax classification.
